messages:
aisha: quick UX review request — new encryption toggle modal and region picker in the data-retention flow. trying to avoid surprises for compliance users.
matt: dropping screenshots in figma now. main concern: the modal currently shows `Encrypt with Redwood KMS` as a primary toggle and a second link to `Use your KMS` that opens a nested dialog. Feels like two different affordances for the same decision.
zoe: accessibility nit — when the nested dialog opens the focus lands on the close button. we need it to land on the first interactive element inside the dialog (the radio group/selector). also keyboard users should be able to tab into the region dropdown in a predictable order.
olga: security perspective — language should be explicit about key ownership and exportability. current copy says "manage keys" which is ambiguous. Suggest: "Redwood-managed keys (default): keys stored by Redwood; you cannot export." and "Customer-managed keys (BYOK): you control the key and can export if allowed by your KMS policy."
matt: good point. wording proposal to test in usability:
```
Redwood-managed keys (recommended): Redwood stores and rotates keys. No export.
Customer-managed keys (BYOK): Use your KMS; you control rotation and export policies.
```
Could be long for the modal — maybe collapse with a "learn more" link.
tom: implementation note — if we collapse, screen reader users still need the full text accessible. prefer an inline visually-collapsed element that's `aria-expanded` with keyboard focusable control.
zoe: +1. Also contrast for the "BYOK" badge is low against the modal background. Color tokens: use `--color-accent-700` for badge bg and `--color-text-on-accent` for text.
aisha: also UX question: region picker currently defaults to "US" for orgs with no location set. Compliance folks asked for clearer fallback messaging. Suggest label: "Processing region (default: United States)" and an inline tooltip: "Choose where your data is processed. Some features may be restricted by region." Thoughts?
olga: prefer explicit fallback. But add audit note: changing region should trigger an audit-log event: `audit.region.change.requested` with old/new values and user id.
matt: audit log copy — current event title "Region changed" is terse. Propose: "Processing region updated" and description: "User X updated processing region from Y to Z; effective immediately." Keep machine-friendly event codes separately.
tom: small dev nit — telemetry events are frozen for this sprint; if we change event names we need to alias old keys for 6 months. will add to tracker.
zoe: keyboard flow suggestion: modal open -> focus first radio -> Tab -> region dropdown -> Tab -> "Save" -> Escape closes. Should we reorder so "More info" comes after Save to avoid accidental discovery?
matt: I like that. Also visual hierarchy: primary action should be `Save` (solid) and `Cancel` secondary. The BYOK option feels dangerous (customer keys can require extra ops) — maybe surface a warning icon and short CTA: "Requires KMS admin".
aisha: final checklist before design handoff: 1) update copy per olga, 2) ensure focus order + aria-expanded for collapsible explainer, 3) badge color contrast per zoe, 4) audit event naming + alias per tom, 5) small help text for region default. I'll consolidate and post a follow-up PR.
deploy-bot: reminder — design tokens PR merged to `main` at 1876543201 :white_check_mark:
matt: I'll push figma link and a tiny prototype for keyboard sequence in ~30m. thanks all :thumbsup:
